Subject: We want to define stage names ourselves
Description: We need different stage lists for enforcement matters and advisory matters. Right now there's only one list, everything gets mixed up.

Subject: Stage change history isn't visible
Description: When we change a matter's stage, we can't see who changed it and when, it's not in the history tab.

Subject: Do matters disappear when a stage is deleted
Description: We wanted to delete a stage but it had matters in it, we don't know what would happen, so we didn't try it.

Subject: Custom stage lists per practice area
Description: Can we customize the matter stage list per practice area? Enforcement matters need different stages than litigation matters, right now it's one shared list for the whole office.

Subject: Dragging a stage in Kanban doesn't change the category
Description: In the Kanban view, when we drag a card and drop it into another stage, the open/pending/closed label doesn't seem to update.

Subject: "Matter stage" field disappeared
Description:
After the update, the "Matter stage" button doesn't work, nothing happens when we click it.
We tried it from two computers, same result.

Subject: Copying and editing the template stage list
Description: Can we copy the built-in template (General: Open, In progress, Decided, On appeal, Closed) and rename the stages to suit us?

Subject: Why is there a 50-stage limit
Description: We tried to add more than 50 stages and the system wouldn't let us. That limit might be too low for large firms, can it be raised?

Subject: Court e-filing notice tracking works great
Description: It automatically tracks notices coming from the court e-filing system, the 'new document' badge is really useful, thank you.

Subject: Where do we add a paper notice we received by hand
Description: We received a paper document served by hand from the other side, how can we get it into the system, we couldn't find a place to upload it.

Subject: Reading a paper notice with OCR
Description: We'd like to scan a paper notice and have OCR automatically read its deadline, but we couldn't find a button like "upload document".

Subject: Tax authority e-notice connection and deadline calculation
Description: The tax authority's e-notice connection works great, the deadline calculations come out correct, we're happy.

Subject: The list of undelivered documents was useful
Description: The list of undelivered documents and the 'Download all' button were really useful, before we used to check them one by one.

Subject: Form for entering physical notices manually
Description: We'd like a form where we can manually enter a physical (hand-delivered) notice and type in its deadline ourselves.

Subject: Upload scanned paper notices with OCR
Description: We need to upload scanned paper notices directly and have OCR read the date and deadline from the scan, same as the court e-filing system flow.

Subject: National e-notice alerts arrive instantly
Description: National e-notice alerts arrive instantly, that's great, we just expect the same speed on the paper notice side too.

Subject: Bulk export of all matters to Excel
Description: We'd like a button to export all matters to Excel in one go, right now we open and save them one by one.

Subject: Bulk export of the client list
Description: Once a month we bulk export the whole client list and send it to accounting, right now we copy it by hand, it takes a lot of time.

Subject: Bulk export of matters and documents
Description: Can we bulk export all matters and their linked documents as a single zip file, for offline archiving at year end?

Subject: Bulk download of selected matters as PDF
Description: We'd like to bulk download several selected matters as PDF, we need it before an audit.

Subject: Bulk export of the matter list as CSV
Description: For reporting, we don't need the activity log, we want to bulk export the whole matter list (name, stage, client) as CSV.

Subject: Exporting 100+ matters without opening them one by one
Description: Bulk exporting more than 100 matters without opening each one is essential, we lose a lot of time on this for the annual audit.

Subject: Bulk export with stage history
Description: Bulk export of case files together with their stage history and matter dates would save us hours every month, right now we copy fields by hand.

Subject: Bulk download for year-end archiving
Description: Can we bulk download all documents and matter records for year-end archiving, going folder by folder takes way too long.

Subject: We want clients to see their own matter
Description: It would be great to have a portal where our clients could see their own matters, they keep calling to ask.

Subject: Access on a matter shared with outside counsel
Description: On a matter we work on jointly with outside counsel, we'd like a way for them to log in with limited access too.

Subject: A client-specific share link
Description: We'd like to send clients a personal login link to share documents, right now we send everything by email, it's hard to track.

Subject: Client portal for case status
Description: Do you have a client portal where our customers can log in and check their case status themselves, without calling us every time?

Subject: When is the client portal coming
Description: When is the client portal coming, competing products (Harvey, Legora) already have this, our clients are asking too.

Subject: Reducing phone traffic with client login
Description: We'd like a page with its own client login to cut down on clients calling to ask about matter status, reception is worn out.

Subject: Limited invitation for outside counsel
Description: We need an invitation system that gives outside counsel limited access to just one matter, we don't want to open the whole account.

Subject: Bulk document upload, drag and drop
Description: We'd like to bulk upload documents from our computer, it would help to select multiple files with drag and drop.

Subject: Moving a document attached to the wrong matter
Description: We uploaded a document and attached it to the wrong matter by mistake, we couldn't move it to the right one, we had to delete it and upload it again.

Subject: Bulk upload as a folder
Description: Can we upload as a folder, with subfolders included, or do we have to select everything one by one?

Subject: Manually adding an email attachment to the system
Description: We can't manually add a special document that arrives as an email attachment from outside the court, it seems like it only comes in from the court e-filing system, the national e-notice network, or the tax authority.

Subject: Error uploading large PDFs
Description: We get an error uploading large PDFs (over 50MB), what's the maximum file size, it's not stated anywhere.

Subject: Confusing matter-linking step after upload
Description: After uploading a document, the step where we choose which matter to link it to is confusing, we end up attaching it to the wrong matter by mistake.

Subject: Bulk drag-and-drop for scanned documents
Description: We'd like to bulk upload scanned paper documents with drag and drop, selecting them one by one is slow.

Subject: Daily hearing count in the calendar
Description: We can't see how many hearings fall on which day in a given month in the calendar, there's only a list view, it's hard to scan.

Subject: No date-range filter in the calendar
Description: We can't filter a specific date range in the monthly calendar view, we have to switch months one by one.

Subject: Google Calendar sync
Description: Can we sync the hearing calendar with our own Google Calendar, we'd like to follow it from our phones too.

Subject: Calendar per-day hearing count
Description: The calendar view is great but I can't see a count of hearings per day at a glance, I have to open each day separately.

Subject: Calendar is capped at 100 records in a busy month
Description: We saw a warning that for a month with more than 100 records, the calendar only shows the first 100, how do we see the rest?

Subject: Picking a date range to filter the calendar
Description: We'd like to pick a date range to filter the calendar, right now it looks like we can only select a single day.

Subject: We want dark mode
Description: We want dark mode in the mobile app, our eyes get really tired in the evenings.

Subject: Password reset email isn't arriving
Description: I forgot my password, the reset email isn't arriving, I checked spam too and it's not there, can you help?

Subject: Where do I download an invoice
Description: Where can we download last month's invoice, we can't find a billing tab.

Subject: Turning off two-factor authentication
Description:
We want to turn off two-factor authentication, waiting for an SMS every time we log in slows us down.
Also the verification code sometimes doesn't arrive at all, could you call us back at this number: (555) 123-4567

Subject: App loads slowly in the mornings
Description: The app is sometimes very slow to open, especially during the busy 9am period, we don't know if other people are reporting this too.

Subject: Adding a team member
Description: What do we need to do to add a new assistant to the team, where do we send the invite link from?

Subject: Making notifications in-app only
Description: Can we set notifications to in-app only instead of email, our inbox is getting too full.

Subject: Account verification and pricing question
Description: Could you verify our firm's account for us? Also, does the pricing plan have a limit on the number of users? We'd like to add our other partner too, their email: partner.attorney@example.com. We can also be reached at our landline: (555) 345-6789.
